tidbit: Did you know… this hour's top stories come from five different outlets.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Washington bans DeepSeek from government agencies, confirmed by Semafor, amid artificial intelligence rivalry between the US and China.
DeepSeek has unveiled an open-source tool, reported by Bloomberg, to help cut artificial intelligence operating costs.
Nvidia GeForce RTX 6060 may not release until 2029, still open per Club386, leaving low-end gamers without a GPU for 44 months due to supply issues.
Artificial intelligence stock sell-off spreads across Wall Street, confirmed by CNBC, with the Elice IPO crashing and CoreWeave shares falling.
Microsoft rolls out artificial intelligence agent controls, confirmed by Help Net Security, to secure hundreds of thousands of agents in enterprise environments when they stray from the job.
Free every hour.
